PROXY FUNCTION: Execute ANY discovered tool by name. After discovering tools via list_platform_tools(), use this to execute them.

Workflow:
1. Call list_platform_tools('google_workspace')
2. See gmail_send_email with parameters: to, subject, body
3. Call execute_tool('gmail_send_email', to='john@example.com', subject='Hello', body='Test')

This allows dynamic tool execution without sending all 603 tool schemas upfront.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool to execute (e.g., 'gmail_send_email', 'google_docs_create_document')

parameters.description: Dict of arguments to forward to the target tool. ALL target-tool arguments belong here -- e.g. parameters={'title': 'My Doc', 'folder_id': 'abc'}. _user_id and _injected_credentials are added by the auth layer and must NOT be supplied here. Top-level kwargs other than `tool_name` are silently dropped by the registry validator, so passing them at the top level (e.g. title=...) causes missing-argument failures downstream in the targeted tool.

returns.description: Result from the executed tool with success/failure and data

examples.description: Correct -- target-tool args go inside the typed `parameters` dict
Correct -- `title` is forwarded under `parameters`, not as a top-level kwarg
INCORRECT -- `to` at the top level is silently stripped. Do NOT do this.
